steps.code:
# Get all songs in the song library
access_token = login_result['access_token']
all_songs = []
page = 0
while True:
    songs = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not songs:
        break
    all_songs.extend(songs)
    if len(songs) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(f"Total songs in library: {len(all_songs)}")
print(all_songs[:3])
